scoping_law.spec_mandate: N13: 'WCET: static + measured cycles per opcode, <= 12 cycles target, measured table published'
scoping_law.delivered: static instruction-count table per opcode exit class (the deliverable) + dependency-depth derivation proving the branchless kernel at depth 12 <= 12 cycles (the spec figure, proven not asserted) + calibrated wall-clock confirmation with disclosed TIMER_MARGIN=64 and corrupted-batch rejection; wall-clock ns are host-frequency-dependent and recorded for reference only

pnabi_validate_and_advance_per_exit_clas.note: source-level op budget (LLVM CSE may only lower it — conservative direction, disclosed)

branchless_step_branchless.depth_derivation: token chain (m&w)^w -> NEG -> OR -> SHIFT -> XOR = 6; valid adds 2 AND levels after deepest predicate (inv chain depth 8 -> valid depth 9); mask = 0-valid = 10; select = 12
branchless_step_branchless.spec_figure: depth 12 <= 12 cycles at 1 ALU op/cycle on any in-order single-issue core — THE '<= 12 cycles' figure, derived

quota_admit.note: pnabi commit row + PN64 pack + fixed 16-iteration per-place loop + popcount leg; all loop counts data-independent

sequencer_next.note: LOAD cycle + wrapping ADD + STORE back; Sequence::order (alloc+sort, data-sized) is OUT of kernel scope and not claimed bounded

court.targets_measured: 6 canonical RONR opcodes (0x01-0x06) x {pnabi branched path, branchless kernel} + quota_admit + sequencer_next = 14 targets, worst-case inputs (maximal popcounts, worst masks: invariant mask full-width, flags/tick 0xFF), 100k batch-means x 1024 calls each

tests.n13_static_instruction_count_table_is_pu: row totals recomputed from columns; exit-class monotonicity; canonical six opcodes tracked live from ronr::RONR; branchless depth 12 <= SPEC_TARGET_CYCLES 12
tests.n13_measured_worst_case_within_static_bo: 14 targets, 100k samples each: max(batch-mean ns/call over uncorrupted batches) <= static_ops x calib_ns_per_cycle x 64
tests.n13_no_input_class_exceeds_bound: 8-class lattice (conforming x enabled x inv_clear) x 6 donors x 10k samples, each class asserted against ITS OWN static row bound, both pnabi and branchless

measured_table_ns_per_call.calibration: 0.4475 ns/cycle (dependent-add chain median, CALIB_BATCHES=401); TIMER_MARGIN=64; corrupted-batch threshold 25x median, max tolerated fraction 0.5% (observed <= 0.001%)
measured_table_ns_per_call.note: pnabi/branchless rows are per opcode 0x01-0x06 (means within 0.01 ns across all six, max variance is scheduler noise); worst observed max (55.50 ns, pnabi op 0x05) still 14x under its bound

findings.note: Zero WCET violations across all 14 targets and all 48 lattice cells (6 donors x 8 classes). Measured maxima sit 15-60x under their calibrated bounds; the binding constraint is the static table, and the branchless kernel's dependency depth lands exactly on the spec figure (12 <= 12).
